programme.title: Rosalinda
programme.desc: Dok služi svoju zatvorsku kaznu, žena dobija dete. Kako bi dobila život koji zaslužuje, dete odlazi da živi sa svojom tetkom.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 16.30 časova, uz Anu Šupić i Boška Jakovljevića, donosi pregled aktuelnih tema iz zemlje i sveta, razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima i priče reportera sa terena. Poseban prostor posvećen je društvu i kulturi – temama koje pokreću javnost, zanimljivim ljudima i događajima koji obeležavaju svakodnevicu, uz razgovore koji nude različite poglede i odgovore na aktuelna pitanja. Uz poznate ličnosti, priče iz sveta kulture i zabave i muziku benda u studiju, Ana i Boško završnicu dana provode sa gledaocima u prepoznatljivoj atmosferi Popodneva – spontano, neposredno i uz dobru energiju.

programme.title: Gradske priče
programme.desc: Gradske priče su novi serijal Una televizije koji beleži neprolazne priče iz prestonice i drugih delova Srbije. Ovo su priče o stanovnicima gradova Srbije i urbanom okruženju koje ih je takvim napravilo. Teme ove emisije nisu aktuelni događaji, već sve ono što atmosferu grada čini jedinstvenom i neponovljivom. Najstrmija ulica, dan sa čistačem cipela, prva kafana u Evropi, najbolji beogradski đaci, najstariji vozač autobusa, pekara koja postoji 100 godina, žena koja godinama popravlja kišobrane, najteže beogradske škole, najbolji beogradski lekari, mesta za okupljanje, sastanke i rekreaciju, čudesna istorija, robinzoni sa Ratnog ostrva, ljudi sa čudnim hobijima, najlepši beogradski balkon, avanture dostavljača hrane, jutro u samačkom hotelu, dan u birou za izgubljene stvari, kako su nastajale tolike pesme u kojima se spominje Beograd, najduži red za pljeskavicu posle noćnog izlaska, tajna najboljeg beogradskog bureka, cenkanje na pijacama, spokojna šetnja u sred noći - sve je to duh jednog grada u kome svaki ćošak krije priču a svaki prolaznik neponovljivu anegdotu.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Alo, alo
programme.desc: Alo, Alo! je kultna britanska humoristična serija, koja se u originalnu prikazivala od 1982. do 1992. godine, u devet sezona. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vredna umetnička dela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku Posrnula Bogorodica. Zapovednik grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa je daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je nađe. U isto vreme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran raditi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što uslužuje Nemce. René se takođe trudi da balansira između afera s konobaricama Ivet, Mariom i Mimi i braka sa Idit.

programme.title: Voleti do smrti
programme.desc: Voleti do smrti je priča o ljubavi, zločinu i osveti koja otkriva tajne života posle smrti. Ovo je priča o drugim prilikama, mogućnosti iskupljenja, mračnim putevima osvete, kao i o odnosu moći i ambicije. Leon Karvahal (Aleksis Ajala) jedan je od dvadeset najbogatijih poslovnih ljudi na svetu. Sa 60 godina odlučuje da se oženi Lusijom Borges (Anhelik Bojer), ženom koja je od njega mlađa tri decenije i izuzetne je lepote. Međutim, venčanje se pretvara u tragediju kada je, usred proslave, slavni milioner ubijen. U istom trenutku događaju se još dve smrti. U zatvoru u Teksasu, na električnoj stolici, pogubljen je opasni ubica poznat kao El Ćino Valdes (Mišel Braun), osuđen na smrtnu kaznu. Istovremeno, profesor Beltran Kamačo (Arturo Barba) gine nakon što njegov automobil sleti u provaliju. Iako se nikada nisu upoznali i njihovi životi nisu bili povezani, sva trojica umiru u istom trenutku, na različitim mestima i pod različitim okolnostima. Njihova smrt pokreće neverovatan niz reinkarnacija koje će zauvek promeniti živote mnogih ljudi.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Kakodalogija
programme.desc: Emisija Kakodalogija, autora i voditelja Ivana Stankovića, otkriva šta se zaista krije iza velikih životnih i profesionalnih ostvarenja poznatih ličnosti i traži odgovor na pitanje – kako se postaje uspešan? Kroz jednosatne razgovore jedan na jedan sa ljudima koji su napravili značajne karijere i ostavili trag u svetu biznisa, kulture, sporta i javnog života, Ivan Stanković istražuje ono što često ostaje izvan poznatih biografija – neuspehe, pogrešne odluke, trenutke sumnje, strahove, prekretnice i izazove koji su oblikovali put njegovih sagovornika. Polazeći od jednostavnog pitanja kako da?, Kakodalogija istražuje kako prepoznati pravu priliku, doneti odluku kada nema dovoljno informacija, nastaviti nakon promašaja ili velikog pada i pronaći snagu za novi početak. Kroz konkretna iskustva gostiju, emisija otkriva koliko su na putu do cilja važni talenat i sreća, a koliko upornost, disciplina, hrabrost i spremnost na promene. Kakodalogija tako prevazilazi okvir klasičnog biografskog razgovora i postaje svojevrsni masterclass o životu, karijeri, ranjivosti i donošenju odluka, nudeći gledaocima ne samo inspiraciju, već i odgovore koji im mogu pomoći u njihovim ličnim kako da pitanjima.

programme.title: (Ne)profesionalac
programme.desc: Ova akciona komedija predstavlja Nobija, koji je simpatični ali glupi navijač, huligan. Poslednjih 28 godina razdvojen je od svog brata Sebastijana. Sebastijan je agent ubica koji ima novi zadatak - treba da spreči teroristički napad. Kada se braća nađu posle toliko godina, Sebastijan će uvideti da i dalje može da bude od pomoći Nobiju.

Zagorci, Međimurci, Podravci, ali i ostali kojima je KAJ u duši u svakoj će od emisija pronaći nešto za sebe - glazba poznatih pjevača i sastava kajkavskog kraja, zanimljive priče i legende, ali i posebnosti koje svojim sadržajem odražavaju duhovitost, vrijednost tradicije te bogatu i znimljivu povijest i puno dobre zabave.

programme.title: VTV TJEDNIK, informativna emisija
programme.desc: donosi pregled najvažnijih događaja u Gradu Varaždinu, Varaždinskoj i Međimurskoj županiji koji su obilježili protekli tjedan. Sve te događaje prikazujemo ponovno, ovoga puta u novom svjetlu, promatrajući ih s vremenske distance, uz najnovije informacije i komentare. Pregled je realiziran tako da se po danima (od ponedjeljka do subote) ponove opširne vijesti koje su obilježile pojedine dane. Emisiju «VTV tjednik» realiziramo s komentarom za slušno oštećene osobe, čime smo uspjeli, na veliko zadovoljstvo, približiti naš informativni program i toj skupini naših gledatelja.

Mostovi: Američki junak Petar Tomich, dokumentarni film
Upoznajmo Hrvatsku - zaronite s nama: Kraljev gaj - otok Šolta
Skica za portret: Srebro svetišta Gospe sinjske
Mostovi: Američki junak Petar Tomich, dokumentarni film
Daydream Believers: The Monkees' Story
programme.desc: In 1966, producers Bert Schneider and Bob Rafaelson come up with the idea of creating a TV show that would feature the American answer to the Beatles, The Monkees. Eventually, four young men are chosen for the roles, Mickey Dolenz the former child TV star, the stage actor Davey Jones and the musicians, Mike Nesmith and Peter Tork. With the aid of a successful music producer and able TV promotion, the Monkees become a sensation. However, that success is tainted, to the chagrin of the band, as they find themselves labeled as talentless phonies. This film covers the band's frustrating struggle to prove their detractors wrong as they struggle to earn some artist legitimacy. Whether it's by learning to excel as a band or experimenting with wild ideas for their show and film, Head, nothing seems to work. Meanwhile the band have their internal tensions as various members struggle to decide what is really important to them...

programme.title: The Howling: Reborn
programme.desc: In the sequel to The Howling. On the eve of his high school graduation, unremarkable Will Kidman finally bonds with the girl he has long yearned for, reclusive Eliana Wynter. But he also discovers a dark secret from his past... that he is about to become a werewolf. 1 Jul 13, in an effort to fight destiny and save their love as well as their lives, they must battle not only Will's growing blood lust but an army of fearsome beasts bent on killing them... and then, us all.

programme.title: Redemption of the Ghost
programme.desc: Convicted embezzler Witt Hampton escapes from prison and while hiding out in an isolated country barn is discovered by young Cassy and her brother Jack. After convincing them he's a friendly ghost that only they can see, the three new friends embark on one imaginative adventure after another until, inspired by their innocent spirits, Witt vows to redeem his crimes. But, a by-the-book sheriff-who has sworn to personally put Hampton back behind bars-is closing in, and Witt may never get the chance to finally set things right.

programme.title: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
Running for Grace
programme.desc: A timeless story set in Hawaii in 1920s, about a young man who transcends the boundaries of race and class in search of forbidden love.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: Sharon Maguire's Oscar-nominated romantic comedy, starring Renee Zellweger, Colin Firth and Hugh Grant. As a New Year's Resolution, a British woman seeks to improve her mundane life and decides to go in search of her perfect companion before having a fling with her boss, keeping a diary of her actions along the way. Celia Imrie is among the co-stars.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: Beeban Kidron's romantic comedy sequel, with Renee Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Colin Firth. Bridget is questioning her romance with Mark Darcy when her sneaky boss Daniel returns, and the possibility of an exotic holiday gives her a chance to run away from it all.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Romantic comedy revolving around complicated love life of Bridget Jones. Bridget is 43 and her mom keeps on reminding her that her time to have a child is running out. She goes to attend the funeral of Daniel Cleaver, and there sees her ex, Mark Darcy and his new wife Camilla. At a music festival she has a one-night stand with a very handsome man Jack. At the christening of Jude's youngest child, she meets Mark again and finds out he is divorcing. They realize they are still in love, and spend the night together. A few weeks later, Bridget finds out she is pregnant, and is unsure if Darcy or Jack is the father.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
Pirates of Somalia
programme.desc: In 2008, rookie journalist Jay Bahadur forms a half-baked plan to embed himself among the pirates of Somalia. He ultimately succeeds in providing the first close-up look into who these men are, how they live, and the forces that drive them.

programme.title: Alex of Venice
programme.desc: A workaholic attorney is forced to reinvent her life after her husband suddenly leaves.

programme.title: Alex of Venice
programme.desc: A workaholic attorney is forced to reinvent her life after her husband suddenly leaves.

programme.title: Fighting Season
programme.desc: A fact-based movie going behind the scenes of recruiting soldiers for the US Army at the end of the first decade of the 21st century. In this rough time, so unfavourable for the soldiery, enlisting volunteers required non-standard actions and some methods of military recruiters could be considered controversial.

programme.title: Whisper Island
programme.desc: Sam Dalton, a 14-year-old girl, is determined to save the only home she has ever known, the faded, dusty Romanian Princess ranch. Sam writes to a distant relative of her Aunt Christine hoping he can prevent the ranch from being repossessed. But it's J. T. Swinton, a teenage boy who shows up. In desperation they turn to a seemingly futile hope, the treasure of Whisper Island. But does the Civil War treasure really exist? The answer seems to be trapped somewhere in the wishful delusions of Aunt Christine. As the teens search for treasure in a race against time, they must also search Christine's past and unravel a web of romance, intrigue and betrayal that spans a lifetime and beyond. What they find, changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Owd Bob
programme.desc: The story of a young orphaned boy who is sent to live with his grandfather in Ireland. The boy finds adjusting to the country life challenging, but soon learns the life has its rewards as well.

programme.title: The Year Dolly Parton Was My Mom
programme.desc: Elizabeth Alison Gray is just your average suburban 11-year old waiting for adolescence to arrive when she finds out her whole life has been a lie. With only her imagination to guide her, she runs away to find the truth.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Wild Fire
programme.desc: Dream Town Development real estate bosses Jack Del Rio and Sy Richards can't convince animal lover Carol Tanner to sell and relocate safari/animal retirement ranch Wild Land, which she runs with younger sister Ballad since their parents died in a plane crash. Jack hires Bradshaw and Roach to release tiger Caesar, after that fails to cause a scandal to start a forest fire and release all animals, after tying up Carol. Ballad's lover, committed Glendora, southern California fire captain Kennedy, and his jumper team try their best to control the fire. Meanwhile young sheriff Drake Donovan and Ballad drug and catch wild animals. The arson is discovered, but the fiends aren't done yet.

programme.title: El camino
programme.desc: Elliot, 31, a product of the Washington D.C. foster care system, has spent most of his life moving from place to place. When he is contacted by Matthew, a childhood friend from "the system" dying of cancer, Elliot goes to be by his side. At the funeral, he meets Gray and Lily, two friends of Matthew, both aimless in their present lives. Motivated by their sense of loss, and personal anger, Gray, Lily and Elliot steal Matthew's ashes and take them to Mexico. As the three travelers journey cross-country with Matthew's urn in tow, they are forced to confront their own sense of family, identity and future. Set against the changing American landscape, EL CAMINO follows these characters as they search for themselves in a country that has lost it's own identity. Gray, the wayward son of a prominent D.C. family, has left his pregnant girlfriend. He is angry, volatile and fearful of commitment. Lily is Matthew's ex-girlfriend. Unbeknownst to her parents, she has dropped out of college and become an exotic dancer. Lost in alcohol and pills she longs for her mother's approval. Elliot is outside the cultural mainstream. He carries a suitcase filled with documents and mementos of his life. An explorer of human experience, he interviews and videotapes people he meets. Haunted by dreams of his mother's drowning, Elliot struggles to find his place in the world. EL CAMINO is a humorous and compassionate film about friendship, family, and search for self in today's American landscape

programme.title: Cigarete na komad
programme.desc: Bobi, njujorški džeparoš koji se svuda predstavlja kao broker, izaziva sudbinu kada krade značku njujorškog detektiva, na nezadovoljstvo svog izuzetno manipulativnog dilera ukradenim stvarima. Igrajući ovu opasnu igru mačke i miša, Bobi nailazi na još veći izazov: vezu za jednu noć, s devojkom po imenu Lusi. Tri meseca nakon strastvene zajedničke noći, Lusi mu saopštava da je trudna. Iznenada, dva potpuno različita sveta se sudaraju, što Bobiju nalaže da preispita dotadašnji život. U gradu za koji je nekad bio nevidljiv, Bobi je sada prilično poznat i tražen.

programme.title: Australijski gangster
programme.desc: Paskal Barbaro (Aleksandar Bertran) izlazi iz zatvora, ali tek kada razvije neprijateljstvo s članom grupe "Braća zauvek", Malim Ludakom (Rahel Roman). Les Elijas (Salvatore Koko) predlaže Barbaru da se poveže s Farhadom "Avganistanskim guruom" (Majkl Vajs), novim vođom grupe "Braća zauvek", koji mrzi Malog Ludaka, i da njihov sukob pretvori u sopstvenu korist.

programme.title: Devojka broj jedan
programme.desc: Producent, režiser i akciona zvezda; to je sve što vam je potrebno da snimite najbolji film svih vremena. Zar ne?

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Deset stvari koje bi trebalo da uradimo pre raskida
programme.desc: Kada Ebigejl, samohrana majka dvoje dece, zatrudni nakon jedne noći provedene s Benom, ovaj neobični par pokušaće da se izbori s novonastalom situacijom.

programme.title: Smrtonosni medeni mesec
programme.desc: Par se venčava na Havajima i za medeni mesec polaze na krstarenje, ali stvari kreću užasno loše

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Ljubav na prvi lajk
programme.desc: Cinična novinarka dobija zadatak da piše o zavodniku sa dejting aplikacija, ali ubrzo otkriva da se iza njegove reputacije krije mnogo više od onoga što je očekivala.

programme.title: Olimpijski snovi
programme.desc: U Olimpijskom selu sportista mlada skijašica se zbližava sa volonterom dok se završava njen takmičarski nastup.

programme.title: Uzmi novac i beži
programme.desc: Ljubav, luksuz i bogatstvo učvršćuju Rujin položaj na vrhu. Dok OneCoin osvaja svet, ona postaje međunarodna zvezda. Međutim, kako raste njena moć, umnožavaju se i neprijatelji. Optužbe za prevaru, izdaje iz najbližeg okruženja i sve veći pritisak prete da sruše carstvo koje je godinama pažljivo gradila.

programme.title: Uzmi novac i beži
programme.desc: OneCoin odavno nije samo kriptovaluta, već pokret čiji je neprikosnoveni vođa Ruja Ignatova. Uverena u sopstvenu nepogrešivost, pokušava da zaključi ambiciozan posao sa uticajnim biznismenom Li Čanom u Hongkongu. Međutim, upravo će taj potez pokrenuti događaje koji će ugroziti sve što je izgradila.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Perspektivnom detektivu dodeljen je slučaj nedavno nestalog deteta, dvanaestogodišnje Grejs Bad.

programme.title: Crni policajac
programme.desc: Crni policajac gurnut je preko ivice, a svoje frustracije istrešće na privilegovanoj zajednici koju se zakleo da će štititi.

Avganistanac optužuje Barbara da je upleten, a jedan od ubica zaduženih za Antonovo ubistvo, još uvek se nije pojavio. Barbaro ga smiruje i govori mu da je njihov posao pri kraju i da će uskoro biti kraljevi grada.

Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi i sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

Meri sa svojim zaručnikom Brentom odlučuje otputovati ka svojoj porodici u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću Brent dobija napad alergije koja ga sprečava da ide na put. Meri odlučuje sa sobom povesti Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora i predstaviti ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to da bude dobra ideja?

programme.title: Gorko-slatko
programme.desc: Ekscentrični i bogati trgovac kafom, šalje priznatog stručnjaka u Tajland, gde treba da otkupi novu, egzotičnu vrstu kafe. Njegov "savršen" život ispada iz koloseka kad se, nakon prvobitne netrpeljivosti, zaljubljuje u prelepu ćerku vlasnika plantaže, a onda otkriva da ga šef ustvari uopšte nije poslao zbog kupovine kafe.

programme.title: Raskinuli smo
programme.desc: Dugogodišnji partneri Lori i Dag raskidaju samo nekoliko dana pre venčanja Lorine mlađe sestre Bi i Džejsona. Da ne bi pokvarili slavlje, odlučuju da se pretvaraju da su i dalje zajedno dok vikend ne prođe.

Kada je primoran da napusti Vegas, seda u svoj stari kadilak i odlazi u Atlantik Siti. Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstva.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca

programme.title: Deset stvari koje bi trebalo da uradimo pre raskida
programme.desc: Kada Ebigejl, samohrana majka dvoje dece, zatrudni nakon jedne noći provedene s Benom, ovaj neobični par pokušaće da se izbori s novonastalom situacijom.

programme.title: Disko
programme.desc: Didje je četrdesetogodišnjak _ fan disko muzike. Muškarac nema posla i još uvek živi sa majkom. Didje ima sina, kojeg dugo nije video, ipak njegova majka ne slaže se da zajedno provedu odmor. Didje odlučuje da pobedi u plesnom konkursu, da dobije nagradu i da povede sina na nezaboravni odmor u Australiju. Muškarac nagovara svoje prijatelje da mu pomognu. Zapošljavaju trenera, koji treba da ih pripremi za takmičenje. Brzo se uspostavlja, da makar nekad bili su odlični plesači, vreme je uradilo svoje. Moraju puno da rade da bi nastupili.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Pravo mesto i vreme za pisanje
programme.desc: Pejdžina majka želi da ćerka krene njenim stopama i preuzme vođenje velikog konglomerata, ali Pejdž želi da bude spisateljica. Kada Džoan odluči da proda izdavačku kuću Atlas zbog manjka klijenata i prihoda, Pejdž to vidi kao priliku da joj pruži poslednju šansu _ ovaj put pišući pod pseudonimom, tako da niko, pa ni Danijel, poslednja nada izdavača, ne zna da upravo njena porodica predstavlja pretnju.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Tinejdžerka tajni agent
programme.desc: Žestoki, snalažljivi privatni detektiv, pristaje da u okviru istrage FBI bude deo tajnog zadatka unutar bratstva na koledžu.

programme.title: Uzmi novac i beži
programme.desc: Dok Ruja Ignatova uživa u bogatstvu i porodičnom životu, istražitelji i oštećeni investitori sve češće dovode u pitanje njeno poslovno carstvo. U Hagu, Europol prikuplja dokaze protiv nje, ali za konačni udarac potreban je ključni svedok. Među onima koji traže pravdu je i Kler Volš, žena koja je u OneCoin uložila sve što je imala.

programme.title: Sumnja
programme.desc: Darel Džejkobs je penzionisani mafijaš koji živi u Finiksu. Kad oboli od raka, shvata da mu vreme ističe, pa svakodnevno posećuje svoj omiljeni kafe. Mlada kelnerica, Ališa Foret, studentkinja prava, zaintrigirana je tajanstvenim redovnim posetiocem, pa ga prati do kuće. Ubrzo započinje prijateljstvo koje Ališu dovodi u opasnost i primorava Darela da dovrši "nesvršena posla". Ališin momak, Tom, ne odobrava njihovo prijateljstvo, pa ih prati. Kad otkrije Darelov pravi identitet, Tom upada u paniku, ali ne zbog bezbednosti svoje devojke. Već zbog svoje.

programme.title: Smrtonosni obračun
programme.desc: Supruga policajca ubijena je kada se njegova porodica zatekla usred pljačke prodavnice. Zbog načina na koji je postupio prema pljačkašima, zbog čega je i došlo do pucnjave, deca ga sada krive za smrt svoje majke.

programme.title: Nasilno srce
programme.desc: Petnaest godina nakon ubistva svoje starije sestre, ćutljivi Danijel zaljubljuje se u živahnu srednjoškolku Kasi, u priči nadahnutoj južnjačkim gotikom, koja donosi savremenu verziju Romea i Julije, smeštenu u srce Amerike.

programme.title: Footprints on the Moon
programme.desc: A woman is tormented by strange dreams of astronauts on the moon. She visits a deserted seaside town whose inhabitants know her although she does not know them.

programme.title: Lady of Burlesque
programme.desc: After one member of their group is murdered, the performers at a burlesque house must work together to find out who the killer is before they strike again.

programme.title: Went the Day Well?
programme.desc: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

programme.title: Quelqu'un derricre la porte
programme.desc: A neurosurgeon with a cheating wife takes an amnesiac into his home and conditions him to believe that the cheating wife is his own and to take the "appropriate" action.

programme.title: The Lady of Musashino
programme.desc: Set in post-war Japan, The Lady of Musashino tells the story of Michiko, a disillusioned young woman trapped in a loveless marriage. She confides in her younger cousin, Tsutomo, and the two become close, but decide not to consummate their affair. He instead becomes involved with the flirtatious Tomiko, who is also conducting an affair with Michiko's husband. When Michiko finds that her husband has abandoned her, she decides to take her fate into her own hands.

programme.title: Daughters, Wives and a Mother
programme.desc: Tashiro coincidentally meets his best friend Sugimoto in a bar very close to the apartment in which Sugimoto's wayward wife is found dead. Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: Smash-up, the Story of a Woman
programme.desc: A successful nightclub singer weds a struggling songwriter, but when his fame eclipses hers, she delves into alcoholism.

programme.title: People We Know Are Confused
programme.desc: Set in Vilnius, a modern city still in search for its relation to the past, three parallel stories with three average people marooned in a state of change, looking to the future with hope, but not letting go of constricting and reassuring fears of their past.

programme.title: Beneath the 12-Mile Reef
programme.desc: Fierce competition among sponge fishermen forces a Greek-American family to fish in the dangerous 12-mile reef area off the western coast of Florida.

programme.title: Too Late for Tears
programme.desc: Through a fluke circumstance, a ruthless woman stumbles across a suitcase filled with $60,000, and is determined to hold onto it even if it means murder.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: Due to a possible cholera epidemic onboard, passengers on a ship are forced to disembark at Pago Pago, a small village on a Pacific island where it incessantly rains. Among the stranded passengers are Sadie Thompson, a prostitute, and Alfred Davidson, a fanatic missionary who will try to redeem her.

programme.title: Go for Broke!
programme.desc: The story of Japanese-American soldiers who fought in Europe during World War II.

programme.title: Indiscreet
programme.desc: A young woman jeopardizes the relationship with the man she loves when a no-account from her past shows up.

programme.title: Sea Dragon
programme.desc: A young fossil hunter makes a groundbreaking discovery, challenging the worldview of 19th century England.

programme.title: They Made Me a Criminal
programme.desc: A champion boxer on the lamb, believed to have committed murder while drunk, takes refuge and finds redemption at a farm for delinquent youths.

programme.title: Brides
programme.desc: Nutsa lives with her two small children in suburb of Tblissi, Georgia. With her Goga, they would bee today a regular family if he hadn't been arrested. Between the wedding in prison and the monthly visits, a routine sets in. Wil they be able to overcome this double reality?

programme.title: The Big Wheel
programme.desc: A brash young midget car race driver lives in the shadow of his famous father, a drunken womanizer, who was killed in an accident years earlier.

programme.title: The Big Wheel
programme.desc: A brash young midget car race driver lives in the shadow of his famous father, a drunken womanizer, who was killed in an accident years earlier.

programme.title: Roaring Abyss
programme.desc: A sound journey accros the mountains, deserts and forests of Ethiopia and its cultural universe. Roaring Abyss will take you through an inedit collection of music recordings of unvaluable importance for the transmission and preservation of the African heritage.

programme.title: Delightfully Dangerous
programme.desc: Young Sherry Williams dreams of having a singing career, and she idolizes her older sister Josephine, who has gone to New York to perform on the stage. When Sherry is distraught just before performing at her school, a visiting Broadway producer encourages her by telling her positive things about her sister. Soon afterwards, Sherry decides to make a surprise trip to New York to visit Josephine _ but what she finds there is not at all what she expected.

programme.title: The Overlanders
programme.desc: It's the start of WWII in Northern Australia. The Japanese are getting close. People are evacuating and burning everything in a "scorched earth" policy. Rather than kill all their cattle, a disparate group decides to drive them overland half way across the continent, from Wyndham in Western Australia through the Northern Territory outback of Australia to pastures north of Brisbane, Queensland.

programme.title: The Last Man on Earth
programme.desc: When a disease turns all of humanity into the living dead, the last man on earth becomes a reluctant vampire hunter.

programme.title: The Man of the Eiffel Tower
programme.desc: French police inspector Maigret investigates the murder of a rich Paris widow and ends up chasing the killer up the Eiffel Tower's girders.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A teenaged girl witnesses her widowed mother's attempt to sustain her family.

programme.title: The Captive Heart
programme.desc: A series of stories about the lives and loves of nine men in a Prisoner of War Camp over five years. Location shooting in the British occupied part of Germany adds believability. The main story is of Hasek (Redgrave) a Czech soldier who needs to keep his identity a secret from the Nazis, to do this he poses as a dead English Officer and corresponds with the man's wife. Upon liberation they meet and decide to continue their lives together. The other inmates' stories are revealed episodically.

programme.title: Made for Each Other
programme.desc: While on a business trip, an ambitious young lawyer meets and immediately falls in love with a stranger. They wed the following day, and tragedy soon strikes.

programme.title: The Southerner
programme.desc: Sam Tucker, a cotton picker, in search of a better future for his family, decides to grow his own cotton crop. In the first year, the Tuckers battle disease, a flood, and a jealous neighbor. Can they make it as farmers?

programme.title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy
programme.desc: Andy Hardy goes to college after serving in the war and finds his sweetheart is engaged to someone else.

programme.title: Outpost in Morocco
programme.desc: Captain Gerard, greatest lover in the Foreign Legion, is assigned to escort an emir's daughter to her father's mountain citadel and find out what he can about the emir's activities. Gerard enjoys his work with lovely Cara, but arrives to find rebellion brewing.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: Chuck Scott gets a job as chauffeur to tough guy Eddie Roman; but Chuck's involvement with Eddie's fearful wife becomes a nightmare.

programme.title: People Are Funny
programme.desc: A comedy based on NBC's "People Are Funny" radio (and later television) program with Art Linkletter with a fictional story of how the program came to be on a national network from its humble beginning at a Nevada radio station. Jack Haley is a producer with only half-rights to the program while Ozzie Nelson and Helen Walker are the radio writers and supply the romance. Rudy Vallee, always able to burlesque himself intentional and, quite often, unintentional, is the owner of the sought-after sponsoring company. Frances Langford, as herself, sings "I'm in the Mood for Love" while the Vagabonds quartet (billed 12th and last) chimes in on "Angeline" and "The Old Square Dance is Back Again."

programme.title: Anna Christie
programme.desc: A troubled young woman comes to live with her estranged father on the New York waterfront. A tough sailor falls in love with her, sparking conflict between her father and her suitor. What neither knows is that she has a secret that could cause her to lose both of them.

programme.title: My Dear Secretary
programme.desc: A budding young writer thinks it's her lucky day when she is chosen to be the new secretary for Owen Waterbury, famous novelist. She is soon disppointed, however, when he turns out to be an erratic, immature playboy. Opposites attract, of course, but not without sub-plots that touch on competitiveness within marriage and responsibility.

programme.title: Jack London
programme.desc: Episodes in adventurous life of the American novelist.

programme.title: Jack London
programme.desc: Episodes in adventurous life of the American novelist.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Marshall Dan Mitchell, who is the law in Abilene, has the job of keeping peace between two groups. For a long time, the town had been divided, with the cattlemen and cowboys having one end of town to themselves, while townspeople occupied the other end. Mitchell liked it this way, it made things easier for him, and kept problems from arising between the two factions.

programme.title: Who Killed Teddy Bear
programme.desc: In New York, a disco hostess is stalked by a sexual predator and she requests help from a vice squad detective who takes a personal interest in the case.

programme.title: My Man Godfrey
programme.desc: Fifth Avenue socialite Irene Bullock needs a "forgotten man" to win a scavenger hunt, and no one is more forgotten than Godfrey Park, who resides in a dump by the East River. Irene hires Godfrey as a servant for her riotously unhinged family, to the chagrin of her spoiled sister, Cornelia, who tries her best to get Godfrey fired. As Irene falls for her new butler, Godfrey turns the tables and teaches the frivolous Bullocks a lesson or two.

programme.title: Ciguenas
programme.desc: A pregnant girl and her childhood friend leave the city to seek help. That takes them on an unexpected coming of age journey of self-discovery during which they reflect on their lives and are faced with decisions that will determine their future.

programme.title: The Pilgrim
programme.desc: Disguised as a priest, an escaped convict makes his way to Texas. He ends up in a small rural town where the townsfolk mistake him for their new church minister.

programme.title: A Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: A ravishing adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's legendary novel, A FAREWELL TO ARMS stars Gary Cooper as Lt. Frederic Henry, a young ambulance driver for the Italian army in WWI, more interested in chasing women than the enemy. When seeking cover during an air raid, he encounters Nurse Catherine Barkley, and the world shifts under his feet. They fall in love, but the war keeps wrenching them apart. These painful separations force Frederic to choose between love and battle, a decision that tests him morally and spiritually, and leads to one of the most rapturously romantic endings of all time.

programme.title: Quality Time
programme.desc: Five thirty-something men in as many separate segments struggle to grapple with the relentless absurdity of their respective existences.

programme.title: The Naked Kiss
programme.desc: Kelly, a prostitute, traumatised by an experience, referred to as "The Naked Kiss," by psychiatrists, leaves her past, and finds solace in the town of Grantville. She meets Griff, the police captain of the town, with whom she spends a romantic afternoon. Kelly finds a job as a nurse in a hospital for handicapped children. The work helps her find her sensitive side in the caring and helping of her young patients. Kelly's path towards happiness is thrown amiss, when she witnesses a shocking event, which threatens not just her happiness, but her mental health as well.

programme.title: The Admiral Was a Lady
programme.desc: Ex-WAVE encounters four fun-loving, work-hating men, all of whom want to marry her.

programme.title: My Favourite Brunette
programme.desc: Ronnie Jackson is a lowly baby photographer who secretly fantasizes about being a private detective. When a lovely baroness actually mistakes him for one and asks him to help locate her missing husband, Baron Montay, Ronnie finds himself agreeing. Several days later he is on death row whiling away the hours until his execution by recounting to a group of reporters the bizarre tale of how he ended up there.

programme.title: Gesture
programme.desc: Ali learns through medical documents the sudden recurrence of his son's incurable genetic disorder. Deciding to hide the matter from the rest of the family, he finds himself helpless and starts behaving strangely.

programme.title: Ginza Cosmetics

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Of Boats And Men

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin is mysteriously going bald—on his back! Keepers suspect two mischievous monkey roommates. Meanwhile, Kristina attempts an eye ultrasound on dolphin Ulysses, needing patience and precision. And it's party time for Garoe the chimp, who celebrates his first birthday with a swinging cake surprise!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with _ especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods _ you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups _ you won't believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that's a good day at the beach.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The charming kangaroo. The cuddly koala. The beautiful Butterfly. The cheerful clown fish. Or the endearing budgerigar _ which is the cutest of them all? Clownfish _ Tropical oceans shimmer with dazzling marine life like the vibrant clownfish. Kangaroo _ Australia's countryside pulses with thousands of bounding kangaroos. Monarch Butterfly _ Monarchs fill the skies, delicate and stunning in flight. Budgerigar _ Social and lively, wild budgies flock in hundreds across Australia. Koala _ Soft-furred and beloved, koalas are one of Australia's most iconic animals.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The legendary wild dingo, the iconic kangaroos, vicious feral cats, the delightfully bizarre platypus and the unmistakably cuddly koala _ all call Australia home. Koala _ Hidden high in gum trees, the koala is one of Australia's most beloved animals. Dingo _ Sleek, agile, and descended from wolves, dingoes are Australia's top land carnivores. Kangaroo _ With powerful legs and iconic bounds, kangaroos embody the spirit of Australia. Wild Cats _ Over 12 million wild house cats roam Australia's diverse landscapes. Platypus _ Unique and mysterious, the platypus is one of Australia's most enchanting creatures.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Since the 1970's, sea lion populations have declined more than 80% along the North Pacific coast. Scientists at the University of British Columbia and the Vancouver Aquarium are working together to help save Canada's iconic and largest pinniped _ the stellar sea lion To help understand why their numbers are dropping, researchers work with the highly intelligent mammals at a unique floating laboratory. At The Open Water Research Station, free swimming seals and sea lions are observed in their natural habitat.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Most sea creatures are predators, from tiny fish to giant squid. Built to hunt and survive, they've evolved into efficient underwater war machines. Stonefish lie in wait, disguised, while sharks, barracuda, and moray eels hunt with speed and precision. Reef fish must dodge lightning-fast barracuda and graceful but deadly moray eels. Lionfish use venomous spines, and stonefish can swallow prey whole. In the ocean's depths, survival is a constant battle—an underwater jungle of razor teeth and stealthy ambushes.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: The ocean is a harsh world where survival depends on feeding and avoiding predators. Sea creatures use camouflage, bright colors, venom, and group behavior for protection. Some hide, others rely on safety in numbers. Even venomous animals must stay alert. From top predators to bottom feeders, each species has evolved unique strategies. Defense includes toxins, teeth, mimicry, and camouflage. Nudibranchs, clownfish, squid, octopus, and orcas are just a few winners in the underwater Race of Life, adapting brilliantly to their environment.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan investigates the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Medical history is full of odd cures—like bloodletting, which still helps in rare cases. Germs were once doubted until a doctor spotted bacteria between his teeth. Fleming later discovered antibiotics by accident. But now, "superbugs" threaten this miracle cure. Refrigeration, once deadly due to toxic gases, evolved thanks to pressure-cooking and may soon use sound waves. From leeches to lab breakthroughs, medicine keeps evolving—what's next?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: The Internet began in 1969 as a Cold War military tool for secure communication. Email followed in 1972. Decades later, Tim Berners-Lee introduced the World Wide Web, linking documents and revolutionizing public access. His idea, once called "vague but exciting," reshaped how we share, protest, and connect. Now, with Web 3.0 on the horizon, the Internet may evolve to understand human needs—what's next in this digital journey?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Take a trip to the Jersey Shore and learn how one of its famous boardwalks helped to inspire the iconic board game of Monopoly. And how did a donkey and an elephant become associated with politics? Plus, what's the difference between top grain leather and full grain leather?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you have ever gone to a hockey game, or gone ice-skating, there is one revolutionary machine that helps keep the fun and action going! And that's all thanks to the Zamboni® Ice Resurfacing Machine. You'll learn how and why it was invented! And ever notice some pistachio nuts are red in color? We'll throw up the red flag and explain why the color is simply a cover up!

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Stars are a bit like human beings. They can be warm or cold, they come in all kinds of shapes and sizes... and, let's face it, they can be dim or bright. And recent discoveries suggest that the number of stars in our galaxy alone, the Milky Way, may exceed 200 billion. Just what are these citizens of the night sky?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don't know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don't know much _ and certainly not nearly enough _ about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it's little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Iridescence causes surfaces to reflect shifting colors due to light interference. Chemiluminescence produces light via chemical reactions, while bioluminescence does the same in living organisms using luciferin and luciferase. Gemstone colors come from structural elements or impurities affecting light absorption. Mechanical plant defenses include thorns, spines, and microscopic features that help plants survive threats.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Vear is when visuals trigger imagined sounds, like the silent thud in the jumping pylon illusion. Retinal fatigue causes afterimages after staring at one color too long. The Müller-Lyer illusion tricks us into seeing equal lines as different lengths due to arrowheads. The Ames Room distorts size perception through skewed architecture. Synesthesia links senses—some people see colors when hearing sounds due to hyperconnected neurons.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: The best all-round snowboarder and skier in the world, explore and assault the southern alps of New Zealand looking for big air and beautiful light to kick off another winter season.

programme.title: Nomads

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: This angry spirit doesn't like being dead and still considers himself the sole owner of lovely Oaklands Mansion.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Bonjour! We're headed to Quebec Province on today's show. First, we get blown away by the thunderous pipes at Montreal's Notre Dame Basilica. After that, we go underneath the city at the Pointe a Calliere archaeology museum. Next, we'll learn about the native ecosystem at the gigantic, indoor, BioDome. Lastly, we'll learn about the 1967 Montreal Expo at the structures that are still visited today.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: This episode we visit the bright lights of Vancouver, Canada. We'll swing along the famous Capilano Suspension Bridge, get tranquil in Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Chinese garden, learn about Captain Vancouver at the Vancouver Maritime Museum, dig up Cesna Em "The City Before the City" at the Museum of Vancouver, and dive into the city's seedy underbelly at the Police Museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling for Chinook Salmon in Prince Rupert then making big run Southbound to Hartley Bay through Grenville Channel!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The desert of Gujarat is hardly the place one expects to encounter a lion, but in the scrub forest of the region Bill does exactly that. Join him as he tracks the lion and many less dangerous creatures from spotted deer to owls and parrots. Around the campfire at night meet the local dance group who is preserving the traditional dances of the area people. A unique experience in a unique region.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Over the years, Bill has been able to find and film all of the great predators of India, but one—the wild Asiatic Dog or Dhole. These illusive and endangered canines have rarely been captured on camera. This is the last great wildlife challenge Bill has yet to conquer…Will he succeed?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya and one of the most fascinating cities in Africa. On our visit we'll see the colonial architecture of a bygone era and the ultra-modern side of town as well. We'll learn the truth behind the "Out of Africa" story and our host gets eye-to-eye with some endangered giraffes.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Amboseli National Park has had several years of drought so we're anxious to see if the famous elephant herds are healthy. Journeys takes to the air and ground to get a count of these incredible animals. Along the way, we visit the local Masai to see how they're adjusting to encroaching civilization and we encounter buffalo, hippos and numerous bird species that make Amboseli so special.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of a mountain bike action movie with the top riders in the world hitting new stunts and tricks that will elevate the sport of freeride mountain biking.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Some of the proof of Einstein's theories had long been elusive, beyond the capabilities of technology, until now. It appears that Einstein is once again triumphant with the latest in deep space observations.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: We're looking hard, but the numbers aren't stacking up, is life on other planets that hard to find? Even signals from an advanced race elude us. Maybe we really are alone in our neck of the galaxy!

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you ever go camping there is one thing you do not want to leave home without, the swiss army knife! We'll explain how it evolved into the most famous knife in the world and how the company's name got "Cut" together! And where did the term "cup of Joe" come from as well as the word java? And we all love a juicy hamburger, so where did these chopped meat patties come from?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how almond nuts get transformed into "milk." And why are movie trailers shown at the beginning of the film? We'll keep your attention so you'll want to stick around for the answer. And learn how detergents make your clothes seem brighter and whiter.

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Radio waves, born from electromagnetism, power wireless tech like phones, TVs, and RADAR. Though invisible, they've transformed society. Discoveries by Galvani, Franklin, and Oersted revealed their power. From melting chocolate to X-rays, EM waves penetrate everything—even the human body. Now, they're helping us explore the brain. What's next for this invisible force?

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Water covers 71% of the Earth's surface and is the medium of life. All life forms and their surrounding ecosystems are dependent upon water, without it we would cease to exist. Director of Notre Dame's Environmental Change Initiative, Dr. David Lodge examines the infestations that are spreading throughout our fresh and salt water systems and clogging our precious waterways.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files

programme.title: What In the World

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: Life on planet Earth is a fragile enough proposition as it is. The Earth is an interconnected system, everything is dependent on everything else, and we as a species should learn how to avoid making things worse than they need to be. In this rather sobering instalment of Desperate Hours our special focus is on Environmental Disasters. We will explore what has actually been done to protect the environment in contrast to the long discussions on this topic. From polluting the planet in various ways to the effects of global warming we contemplate how our future might be affected. As custodians of the planet, are we not better to be safe, rather than sorry?

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We've got our own private Idaho in Boise. We'll tour one of the most stunning buildings in the frontier west at the Idaho State Capitol, dance all night with the Basques at the Basque museum and cultural center, soar to new heights at the Warhawk Air Museum in Nampa, and get a shiver down our spines at the Idaho state penitentiary.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: In this episode we visit the Kennedy Space Center located on Florida's famous "Space Coast." We'll speak to NASA engineers about the past, present and future of American space travel, as well as take a look at the attractions KSC has to offer.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Humpback Whales, perfect water, summer sunshine and one of the finest fishing Chinook Salmon solo fishing days!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space. We fly around Mount Everest, arguably the world's most famous mountain, before heading into Chitwan National Park. In Chitwan, Bill searches for tigers from the back of an elephant and observes the myriad of wildlife that call the park home.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no figure in Indian history that rivals Gandhi. Bill explores the land Gandhi called home and in the process, learns about the man himself. But Ahmedabad is more than Gandhi…its rich history and unusual architecture is revealed.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is definitely the land of the elephant. Large herds of pachyderms roam this marshy park putting on a show for whoever wants to watch. But that's not the only big boys of this park—buffalo, lion and a host of hoofed game make this a wonder to behold.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This under-visited, and far western Kenyan park area, is renowned for its giant flamingo gatherings that literally turn lakes pink. We explore these many parks on foot, in a safari vehicle and on horseback searching out the local legends that have marked this region the death zone. Our host faces imminent doom in three unique parks in this fast-paced episode.
